description: For competitive ad research: top-performing ads from TikTok Creative Center's public Top Ads library for 1-5 countries over the last 7, 30 or 180 days, optionally filtered by industry, campaign objective and language. Returns caption, brand when shown, industry, objective, CTR and likes as published, video length, cover image and video links and the Creative Center link; with include_details also landing page, countries, shares and comments. Billed per ad returned (details billed extra).

countries.description: 1-5 two-letter country codes, e.g. US, GB, DE.

include_details.description: Add landing page, countries, shares and comments (billed per ad detail; default false).

industries.description: Optional Creative Center industries, e.g. Beauty & Personal Care, Financial Services.

languages.description: Optional ad language codes, e.g. en, es.

limit.description: Ads to return in total (default 20, max 50).

objectives.description: Optional campaign objectives, e.g. Traffic, Conversions, App Installs, Lead Generation.

name: tiktok_top_ads
title: Top TikTok ads (Creative Center)
